title: Luv Kush
desc: After Ram returns to Ayodhya, Sita is forced to go into exile. She gives birth to twins Lav and Kush, who later go to Ayodhya to attain blessings of Ram and recite the Ramayan.

title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.

title: Shaan
desc: Two brothers go after the international mafia kingpin who murdered their cop brother. They are later joined by another man who wants revenge against the gangster.

title: Aadmi Aur Insaan
desc: Jai and Munish's friendship is ruined when both of them fall in love with the same girl, Meena. Things take a turn when Munish finds out Jai was involved in the case of a faulty railway bridge.
